summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to publish its annual Environmental, Social, and Governance Impact Summary for the year ended December 31, 2025. The filing is a routine disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16 and does not involve any merger, acquisition, tender offer, strategic review, or other special situation. No deal terms, stakeholder actions, or extraordinary corporate events are described; it is purely an ESG reporting document. There is no transaction to watch or risk-arb angle.
